source_citation: Chandler, Zilberman and Sprintall(2022), Seasonal to Decadal Western Boundary Current Variability From Sustained Ocean Observations, doi:10.1029/2022GL097834.
axis_method: Author midpoint depth integration and five-point triangular smoothing weights1,2,3,2,1 divided by9; reject two longitudinal edge points. Select minimum northward integrated velocity only at native longitude<34.4E, exactly retaining the source IX21 restriction rather than inheriting the EAC whole-transect operator.
axis_gate_interpretation: Additional OSW identity plausibility check30–34.4E after source restricted selection. Outside-gate axes remain unknown; gate does not force an alternate minimum. East Madagascar flow further east cannot win the source restricted selector.
vertical_method: At each monthly horizontal axis retain all native depths of maximum positive poleward speed. Diagnose first descending0/0.05/0.1m/s crossings below the deepest tied maximum only between adjacent finite native levels. Missing samples stop diagnosis; no extrapolation to seabed or1975m terminal depth.
seasonal_method: For each calendar month combine16 year-specific current-following axis profiles. A mean value at a native level requires all16 profiles finite at that level, keeping contributors fixed. Diagnose the mean profile separately from individual monthly-profile crossings. No3month smoothing and no averaging of diagnosed depths is substituted for a velocity-profile mean.
reconstruction_scope: Monthly sections2004–2019 combine HR-XBT, Argo and SLA; they are reconstructed estimates, not192 independent direct sections. Deep observations are statistically extended below800m for IX21. Source reference velocities near1000m are time-invariant means.1975m is the product limit, not current bottom.
velocity_uncertainty_scope: Source vel_err is the standard error of Argo reference velocity, not depth uncertainty. Retain variable metadata but do not manufacture depth confidence intervals or transfer transport standard errors.
geometry_scope: One nominal regional IX21 transect from Durban toward Port Louis; it is not the full Agulhas Current route and need not be normal to the flow. No cross-section shape, full-route thickness, width or volume inferred.
